$ corvex run --help

--- stdout ---
Run the orchestration loop: DAG resolve → Worker → Reviewer → checkpoint → next.

Usage:
  corvex run <project> [flags]
  corvex run [command]

Available Commands:
  kill        Signal a live run to stop
  list        List runs across every repository
  pause       Hold a live run at its next wave barrier
  resume      Let a paused run continue
  retry       Re-execute one step without redoing the rest
  show        Show one run: steps, gates, retries and cost
  start       Execute pending steps of a recipe or project
  watch       Redraw a run's screen until it finishes

Flags:
      --ab string       A/B run two models against one task (e.g. --ab sonnet,opus); requires --task
      --approve-gates   auto-approve recipe human-gate stages (otherwise a gate stops the run)
      --dry-run         show execution plan without running
      --env string      environment to stand up around the run: simple (default) or stack (the validate: stack, database included)
      --force           run even if the working tree is dirty, discarding uncommitted changes first (DESTRUCTIVE)
  -h, --help            help for run
      --here            run from the current directory even when a worktree exists for this project (rarely correct — usually you want to cd into the worktree)
      --no-recompile    run the compiled DAG as it is, even when the recipe changed
      --no-replan       fail if spec.md drifted instead of auto-regenerating tasks.md (protects manual edits)
      --plain           disable TUI, use plain log output
      --recompile       recompile the recipe over the compiled DAG, DISCARDING the status of every step
      --single          run only the next pending task
      --skip-doctor     skip the pre-run config checks (corvex doctor)
      --task string     run only a specific task (e.g. S03)
      --validate        run integration validation after all tasks complete
  -y, --yes             skip the cost-preview confirmation prompt (for CI/scripts)

Global Flags:
      --no-color   Disable color output
  -q, --quiet      Suppress per-task progress; print only failures/errors and the final summary

Use "corvex run [command] --help" for more information about a command.

--- stderr ---
(empty)

(nil)
